name: proto-blocks/oit-blog-header
title: OIT Blog Header
description: Top-of-page block for single blog posts. Light-grey to white gradient background with a breadcrumb (Home > Blog > current), then a centered post date, the post title as an h1, and a centered row of category tag chips. Everything is auto-driven from the current post. Use as the first block in the post template.

parentUrl.label: Parent crumb URL
parentUrl.help: Leave empty to use the site's Posts page (or home if none is set).

titleOverride.label: Title override
titleOverride.help: Leave empty to use the post title.
